changes.title: Trump dismisses concerns from families about grim conditions aboard USS Lincoln
changes.summary: President Donald Trump on Friday dismissed concerns from families of service members about the grim conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, whose deployment had been overextended in the Middle East due to the Iran war.
